title: Hexcel to Showcase Advanced Composite Solutions at Farnborough International Airshow
summary: Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL), a global leader in advanced lightweight composites technology, today announced its participation in the upcoming Farnborough International Airshow , July 20-24, 2026. As a vertically integrated supplier, Hexcel delivers a full range of high-performance composite materials used extensively across commercial aerospace, defense, and space applications. “The Farnborough Air Show provides an important platform to highlight the continued innovation and collaboration driving the aerospace industry forward,” said Tom Gentile, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer President, Hexcel Corporation. “At Hexcel, we are proud to partner with our customers to deliver advanced lightweight composite solutions that improve performance, increase efficiency, and enable the next generation of aircraft and space platforms.” Throughout the event, Hexcel will meet with longstanding customers and cultivate new relationships across the global aerospace ecosystem.
